dependency: Task 188 output, port 8012 eighteen-row match and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 191 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Existing points remain search anchors only and all rows stay NOT_BOUND.

features.name: 1 Cabot Square
features.official_source_evidence: Canary Wharf Group's completed-project identity is retained as the primary estate/developer source. Authoritative building records identify One Cabot Square as a 21-storey commercial office building in Canary Wharf.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. Exact building footprint and current parcel evidence remain pending.

features.name: Anglesey Abbey
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Anglesey Abbey as a Jacobean-style house at Quy Road, Lode, Cambridge, CB25 9EJ and separately identifies the house, gardens and watermill.
features.classification_finding: The principal standalone house is clearly identified, but the tracked Detached Home taxonomy requires review because this is a heritage visitor property with gardens and a mill rather than an ordinary occupied residence.

features.name: Doncaster iPort
features.official_source_evidence: The official iPort domain is retained as the primary development source, although automated access currently presents a verification page. Public planning and transport records identify iPort as a strategic rail freight interchange with substantial warehousing and logistics space.
features.classification_finding: The tracked entity is a multi-building logistics and rail-freight development, not one Industrial Unit. A specific warehouse or unit must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: Bullring Birmingham
features.official_source_evidence: The official Bullring and Grand Central site presents shops, major brands, dining and visitor functions at the Birmingham retail destination.
features.classification_finding: Retail Property is strongly supported, but Bullring is a large multi-building shopping complex linked with Grand Central. A documented complex-level policy or specific retail-building footprint is required before exact geometry binding.

features.name: 5 Broadgate
features.official_source_evidence: Make Architects identifies 5 Broadgate as a built London workplace project for British Land and as UBS's headquarters, with trading floors and multiple levels of offices.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is directly supported by the project architect's detailed building record. Exact footprint and parcel evidence remain pending.

features.name: Waddesdon Manor
features.official_source_evidence: The official Waddesdon site identifies the manor as a French Renaissance-style chateau created by Baron Ferdinand de Rothschild, with a separately defined house, gardens and visitor estate at Waddesdon, Aylesbury HP18 0JH.
features.classification_finding: The principal house is strongly identified, but Detached Home is not a clean production taxonomy match for a major heritage chateau and visitor estate. Preserve the row pending category-policy review.
